sources.enabled: true draws the flight inset on every fixed view of a flight clip (--ball-flight); false leaves the frames as they are.
sources.position: Corner the inset is anchored to: top_right, top_left, bottom_right or bottom_left. A top inset starts below the view label and stacks below any panel it shares an edge with; a bottom inset sits above the HUD rows and above such panels.
sources.width_fraction: Inset width as a fraction of the frame width.
sources.height_fraction: Preferred inset height as a fraction of the frame height; it shrinks to fit the free space.
sources.min_height_fraction: Smallest height fraction; with less free space the inset is not drawn.
sources.edge_margin_px: Clear pixels between the inset and the frame edge.
sources.panel_gap_px: Clear pixels between the inset and the impact panels or the HUD rows.
sources.padding_px: Inner pixels between the inset border and its plots.
sources.profile_share: Share of the inset height taken by the side profile; the plan view takes the rest.
sources.opacity: Darkening of the inset background (0 none, 1 black).
sources.vertical_exaggeration: Vertical scale of the side profile and the lateral scale of the plan view relative to the down-range scale: 1 is true aspect, larger exaggerates so a low apex and a small side offset are readable, null always fits the inset. Either way the curve never leaves its plot.
sources.min_lateral_half_span_m: Smallest half width of the plan view in metres, so a near straight shot does not fill it.
sources.hide_before_launch: true hides the inset until the ball is launched; false shows empty axes.
sources.min_flight_fraction_shown: Fraction (0-1] of the flight time (impact to landing) the clip must reach by its last frame for the inset to be drawn. The decision is made once per clip: a short slow-motion impact-window clip, whose plots would be empty lines hiding the club, gets no inset (and the carry ring label back); a real-time flight clip, which runs to landing, keeps it.
sources.curve_color_rgba: Colour and opacity of the flight curve (0-255 each).
sources.curve_width_px: Width of the flight curve in pixels.
sources.ground_color_rgba: Colour of the ground line of the side profile.
sources.target_line_color_rgba: Colour of the target line of the plan view.
sources.dot_color_rgba: Colour of the dot at the ball's current position.
sources.dot_radius_px: Radius of that dot in pixels.
sources.roll_color_rgba: Colour of the roll ground track after the landing point and of its label (only when the export reports a roll; the roll is a model assumption, see rollout_settings.json).
sources.marker_color_rgba: Colour of the apex and landing markers.
sources.marker_radius_px: Radius of those markers in pixels.
sources.title_color_rgb: Colour of the two plot titles.
sources.font_height_fraction: Label height as a fraction of the frame height (before font_scale).
sources.font_scale: Multiplier of every inset font size.
sources.unit: Unit text shown in the labels; use with unit_scale (yd with 1.0936).
sources.unit_scale: Factor applied to the metres of the flight model for the labels.
sources.apex_label_format: Apex label; {apex} = the model's apex times unit_scale, {unit} = unit. Shown once the ball has passed the apex.
sources.roll_label_format: Roll label; {roll} and {total} = the model roll and carry+roll times unit_scale, {unit} = unit. Shown once landed beneath the carry label; keep (model) in it (the roll is a model assumption, stated in full in the HUD).
sources.carry_label_format: Carry label; {carry} = the model's carry times unit_scale, {unit} = unit. Shown once landed.
sources.side_label_format: Landing offset label of the plan view; {side} = the side offset times unit_scale, {unit}, {direction} = side_left_text or side_right_text. Shown once landed.
sources.side_left_text: Direction text for a landing left of the target line.
sources.side_right_text: Direction text for a landing right of the target line.
